title: Puebla Cathedral
geometryBasis: The named historic cathedral footprint, two mapped belfry corners and crossing dome define position and orientation. The standing roof arrangment was interpreted from the cleared aerial footage and nadir still.
sectionBasis: The Qualla drone views establish open stacked arched belfries, the triple dark stone facade, gray-brown vaulted roof, brick-red crossing drum, and gold and green glazed dome. Heritage documentation gives the approximate tower height.
limitations: Fine sculpture, glaze ornament and the exact rear elevations are generalized.
The model covers the principal exterior envelope. Separately mapped surroundings, the atrium and the interior fall outside this scope.
Thirty-metre surface elevation is coarser than facade-level grade changes.
